pr_title: fix keys getting stuck + minor refactor & optimizations to keybind handling
pr_body:
#### Describe your PR, what does it fix/add?

Fixes #4013 

It's fixed by keeping track of mods pressed at the time of key activation and using this info to correctly handle a case, where key was pressed before mod.

Analogous issue with `bindr` was also fixed.

Also:
- Remove unnecessary duplicate `handleKeybinds` calls, which were supposed to be "keycode check runs" but in reality didn't do anything useful.
- "Merge" 3 related params in `handleKeybinds` to a single `SPressedKeyWithMods`

#### Is there anything you want to mention? (unchecked code, possible bugs, found problems, breaking compatibility, etc.)

Nothing in particular.

#### Is it ready for merging, or does it need work?

- ~I'm not sure what to do on line 323.~
- ~Maybe code around 323-327 could be optimized, since the lambdas are the same. But idk C++ good enough to think of any improvement.~
pr_comments:
> Maybe code around 323-327 could be optimized, since the lambdas are the same. But idk C++ good enough to think of any improvement.

Addressed this in [d6d1f52](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/pull/4304/commits/d6d1f5243336fd7371657b1ce4c807b83e81a947)
Wait, there's a bug, when Press(Mod)+Press(Key)+Release(Mod)+Release(Key) a release for Key is sent

Oh wait, it was there before, so it's a different bug, not a regression

I use https://config.qmk.fm/#/test for testing btw

I think there's now a bug with `bindr` for mouse buttons not working  

Probably the same thing would need to be done in `onMouseEvent` that was done for `onKeyEvent` with saving mods at press time

Because right now for "mouse:<some_code" events `SPressedKeyWithMods` is passed with `modmaskAtPressTime == 0` so the `bindr` handler will not get called 

> "Merge" 3 related params in handleKeybinds to a single SPressedKeyWithMods, since they all are either set or not set.

oh, well that is no longer true. I might revert that change and pass 3 of them separately.

`bindr` with mouse buttons still not working

I figured out that it gets shadowed on-press, and on-release gets skipped because shadowing check here: https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/ef2fe9e057be6fe75c9d674e322e761487d8b00c/src/managers/KeybindManager.cpp#L480

But it worked before, so I must've fked up somewhere, and I've yet to discover it.

In what situations is shadowing even useful? I can't figure it out.

> In what situations is shadowing even useful? I can't figure it out.

```ini
bindr = SUPER, SUPER_L, exec, $launcher
bind = SUPER, E, exec, $fm
```

Another bug, probably related to the previous one:

This is not working (command is not executed):
```
bindr = SUPER, SUPER_L, exec, $launcher
```

But I see where's the problem: I assumed that `MODS` include the currently pressed key when pushing to the pressed keys here https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/ef2fe9e057be6fe75c9d674e322e761487d8b00c/src/managers/KeybindManager.cpp#L311
They don't.

> Another bug, probably related to the previous one:
> 
> This is not working (command is not executed):
> 
> ```
> bindr = SUPER, SUPER_L, exec, $launcher
> ```

this is fixed now



> `bindr` with mouse buttons still not working

this is still not working
I've fixed all issues I've discovered above. Ready for review again

issue_context.title: Keys being "toggled" if while pressed SUPER is also pressed.
issue_context.body:
### Hyprland Version

Hyprland, built from branch main at commit e40e486f61f2643578b9977b86f408799dbc75fd dirty (renderer: better checks for special rendering in renderWorkspaceWindows). Tag: v0.32.3-50-ge40e486f  flags: (if any)

### Bug or Regression?

Bug

### Description

With a bind like `SUPER+Q` to open the terminal, if while holding `Q` I were to tap `SUPER`, then, even after releasing all keys, `Q` stays "pressed".

It only seems to happen with keys used in binds, I haven't tested if the same would happen using a modifier key other than `SUPER`.

key goes _**brrrrrrr**_

### How to reproduce

With a bind, like `SUPER+Q`  (MODS: `SUPER` + key: `Q`),
while holding `Q`, press `SUPER`, then release keys,
`Q` acts like its still being pressed.

### Crash reports, logs, images, videos

_No response_
comments:
It happens with other modifier keys as well.
I have Alt+Tab, and if I mess up the order, then Tab gets stuck in a repeating state.
Pressing a non-modifier key will stop it.
I can reproduce it only in terminals, other input fields in other programs work fine.
Other compositors (river, wayfire) don't have this issue.

Additionally, mouse shortcuts are stuck too if you try to use them in the wrong order. The steps are the same, except you press a mouse button instead of a key.
For example, if you use `bindm = $mainMod, mouse:272, movewindow`, then open a terminal/browser, start selecting text in the window/on a webpage with the left mouse button, while holding the button, press and hold the modifier key, release the mouse button, then release the modifier key. Even with the button released, moving the mouse will select more text.
